tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Screen background behind lists, cards, and sheets. Linen in light, warm charcoal in dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Inset list groups, cards, bottom sheets, and text fields, on canvas.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and doodle strokes, on canvas, surface, and accent-tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Meta lines and helper text, on canvas and surface. 4.67:1 on light canvas, 6.7:1 on dark surface.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers between rows inside a list group, and the sheet grabber. Decorative only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Outlines of chips, secondary buttons, steppers, segmented controls, checks, and text fields. At least 3:1 on canvas and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Persimmon. Fill of the one primary button per screen, the check of a bought item, and the active tab. Never running text.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill. 5.2:1 in light, 7.1:1 in dark.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Accent-colored text such as use-soon labels, selected chips, and text buttons, on canvas, surface, and accent-tint. 5.1:1 or more in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Background of use-soon pills, selected chips, and selected segments. Text on it is accent-ink or ink.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Only for Past date and failed saves, always with those words, on canvas and surface. Told apart from accent by its words, not by hue alone.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Solid 2px keyboard focus ring with a 2px offset, on every surface.

groups.name: Titles
groups.note: Apple's serif, New York, through the iOS generic family ui-serif. Titles only.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: The dish name on the Tonight card and recipe pages.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Bottom sheet titles and empty-state headlines.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: The iOS system font (SF Pro) at the iOS default Dynamic Type sizes.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: List section headers: Fridge, Freezer, Pantry, and Staples above their groups.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Button labels and emphasized row names.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Brown the pork, then add the doubanjiang.
styles.usage: Row names, recipe steps, and running text.

styles.name: subhead
styles.usage: Meta lines under row names and chip labels.

styles.name: footnote
styles.usage: Helper text and notes under controls.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips, and inside pills.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of list rows, and gaps inside a sheet.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen gutter and list row side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections, and the bottom padding of sheets.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Around empty-state doodles.

radius.note: Soft everywhere. Every pressable shape is a capsule.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Text fields and segmented controls.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Inset list groups and cards.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, use-soon pills, and steppers.

size.note: Minimum touch sizes from Apple's Human Interface Guidelines.

tokens.name: tap-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything pressable.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a list row with a meta line.
